title: Discrepancy Detection at the Data Level: Toward Consistent Multilingual Question Answering
findings: The MIND pipeline successfully identified factual and cultural/doctrinal discrepancies in religious and spiritual topics. For example, it found differing beliefs about the requirement of a supreme being in Freemasonry between English and German sources, and doctrinal differences about the Eucharist between Catholic and Methodist sources. It also identified historical discrepancies regarding conflicts involving Muslim nations.
